(FAQ)

Questions

Will customers know it is an AI?

Yes. We set it up to say so. People mostly care that they got a fast, correct answer and a booked time.

What if it does not know the answer?

It says so and hands the conversation to you or your team with the full transcript, instead of guessing.

Does it work with my calendar and phone number?

It works with the common calendars and booking tools and can use your existing number or a new one. We confirm your setup on the strategy call.

Is my customer data safe?

Conversations are stored in your systems, access is limited to your team, and we never use your data to train public models.
